Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on and relayed a misleading Bing snippet claiming “Seoul High School … is located in Seoul, Virginia, USA” without clicking through to verify with authoritative sources. In reality, Seoul High School is in Seoul, South Korea (Seocho-gu). This unverified, incorrect location led the Planner to conclude both schools are in the same country.
